pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the first step in understanding a poem? (1 mark)
   A. Read the title and the poem aloud
   B. Tear it
   C. Ignore it
   D. Copy it

2. Which sentence is a metaphor? (1 mark)
   A. The classroom was as busy as a beehive.
   B. The classroom was like a beehive.
   C. The classroom was a beehive.
   D. The classroom was busy.

3. Which interjection shows sudden understanding? (1 mark)
   A. Yuck
   B. Aha
   C. Oops
   D. Ouch

4. What is a hobby? (1 mark)
   A. A test
   B. A school rule
   C. A punishment
   D. Something you enjoy doing regularly in your free time

5. Why do writers use interjections in dialogues? (1 mark)
   A. To hide the story
   B. To fill the page
   C. To make it longer
   D. To show feelings and make speech natural

6. Why should instructions be clear? (1 mark)
   A. So people are confused
   B. So they are longer
   C. So the listener can do the right thing
   D. So nobody listens

7. What should you do while another speaker is talking in a debate? (1 mark)
   A. Leave
   B. Listen without interrupting
   C. Laugh
   D. Talk loudly

8. What is a paragraph? (1 mark)
   A. A page number
   B. One word
   C. A group of sentences about one main idea
   D. A title

9. What is a line in a poem? (1 mark)
   A. A whole page
   B. A book
   C. One row of words
   D. A stanza

10. What is skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Reading quickly to get the main idea
   B. Reading backwards
   C. Reading slowly for every word
   D. Copying the text

11. What is scanning? (1 mark)
   A. Looking quickly for a specific piece of information
   B. Writing a story
   C. Singing
   D. Reading for the main idea only

12. Which line is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Amina: Hurray! It is Saturday.
   B. Hurray Amina: it is Saturday
   C. It is Saturday Amina Hurray
   D. Amina Hurray! It is Saturday

13. In grammar, a verb is a word that (1 mark)
   A. names a person
   B. shows an action
   C. joins two sentences
   D. names a place

14. Which word must begin with a capital letter in the middle of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. Monday
   C. weather
   D. morning

15. What does the Kiswahili proverb Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa teach? (1 mark)
   A. Never use your hands
   B. Lice are dangerous
   C. We need to work together
   D. One finger is very strong

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Copy this sentence correctly: the food is hot (2 marks)

17. Write four numbered steps for crossing a road safely. (4 marks)

18. Choose one proverb and explain its meaning. Then describe a real situation at school where it would apply. (5 marks)

19. Describe how a class can collect and keep cultural songs from the community. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Read the title and the poem aloud
   Reading aloud comes first.

2. C — The classroom was a beehive.
   A metaphor says one thing is another.

3. B — Aha
   Aha shows realising something.

4. D — Something you enjoy doing regularly in your free time
   A hobby is a regular enjoyable activity.

5. D — To show feelings and make speech natural
   Interjections show emotions.

6. C — So the listener can do the right thing
   Clear instructions prevent mistakes.

7. B — Listen without interrupting
   Good debaters listen.

8. C — A group of sentences about one main idea
   A paragraph has one main idea.

9. C — One row of words
   Poems are written in lines.

10. A — Reading quickly to get the main idea
   Skimming gives the general idea.

11. A — Looking quickly for a specific piece of information
   Scanning searches for a detail.

12. A — Amina: Hurray! It is Saturday.
   It has name, colon and words.

13. B — shows an action
   Verbs show actions.

14. B — Monday
   Days of the week begin with capital letters.

15. C — We need to work together
   One finger cannot crush a louse, so cooperation is needed.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The food is hot.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the capital letter and one mark for the full stop.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 1. Stop at the edge. 2. Look right, left and right. 3. Listen for vehicles. 4. Cross when the road is clear.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each correct step in a sensible order.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct proverb with a sensible meaning and a matching situation, for example A stitch in time saves nine means fix small problems early, such as mending a small tear in a uniform before it grows.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the proverb, two marks for the meaning and two marks for a clear situation.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ask elders politely, listen carefully, write or record the song with permission, note the name of the person who shared it and the date, and store it in a class portfolio.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each of four correct steps.
